Field IDs are those in the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary. Every row in the suite is synthetic.

The legacy list in the DF-DEC-014 row is the minimum content of actions. The grant, incident and review-due elements of the decision-log read are named grantId, incidentReference and reviewDueAt; these are working names until the contract baseline of rwb-decision publishes them. AC-VERS is accepted as an access code and mapped like the other access codes; its subject is not fixed here.
